svg.title: Design reference - source page 45
svg.desc: MENGKETE MINGZHU HOT SPRINGS Master Plan PLAN KEY 01 Main entrance 02 Landscaped car park 03 Hot spring hotel and reception centre 04 Hot spring facilities, showers and changing rooms 05 Outdoor thermal bathing 06 Moisturising mist and drinking-water demonstration facility and hiking rescue centre 07 Karaoke plaza and beer garden 08 Ancient Trail performance plaza 09 Sunshine Park children’s play area 10 Private hot spring cabins 11 Historic hot spring viewpoint 12 Leisure cabins 13 Viewing platform 14 Timber boardwalk 15 Motorhome campsite 16 Stargazing tent campsite 17 Streamside tent campsite YUANWANG / HOT SPRING DESIGN 045 / 118 Drawing-label key: 入口 = entrance; 出口 = exit; 前厅/接待 = lobby/reception; 更衣室 = changing room; 男更衣 = men's changing; 女更衣 = women's changing; 淋浴 = showers; 卫生间 = WC; 泳池 = swimming pool; 儿童池 = children's pool; 泡池 = bathing pool; 私汤 = private bath; 水疗 = hydrotherapy; 水吧 = poolside bar; 休息区 = rest area; 设备间/机房 = plant room; 储藏 = store; 办公 = office; 餐厅 = restaurant; 楼梯 = stairs; 电梯 = lift; 水景 = water feature; 绿地 = landscaped area; 总平面图 = master plan; 首层/一层 = ground floor; 二层 = first floor; 剖面图 = section; 图例 = legend. Original English numbered legends are retained.
